name: DY Corporation
summary: DY Corporation, established in 1978 and based in Incheon, South Korea, specializes in the global manufacturing and distribution of hydraulic cylinders, automotive parts, and various industrial machinery. Its extensive product lineup includes construction and specialized equipment such as concrete pump vehicles, stick cranes, knuckle cranes, brick cranes, automated car washing systems, and golf carts, alongside their respective attachments. The company also supplies heavy equipment like excavators, aerial work platforms, forklifts, wheel loaders, and backhoe loaders. Additionally, DY Corporation produces vehicle components such as windshield wiper systems, power window motors, and cooling fan motors. The firm was previously known as Dongyang Mechatronics Corp. before adopting its current name in January 2015.
